scenes.title: Gemini
scenes.sub: Google's multimodal model family behind the Gemini app, the Gemini API, and Antigravity.
scenes.say: This is Gemini, Google's family of multimodal models.

scenes.heading: What it is
bullets: Powers the Gemini app and the Gemini API
scenes.say: Gemini powers the Gemini app, the Gemini API, and Google's Antigravity agent.

scenes.heading: How it runs
steps: Gemini app, AI Studio, Gemini API, Vertex
Through the Antigravity IDE and CLI
scenes.say: The models run in Google's cloud, through the Gemini app, AI Studio, the Gemini API, and Vertex. The Antigravity agent runs in Google-hosted sandboxes, or locally through the Antigravity IDE and command line.

scenes.heading: Timeline
items: Antigravity agent in the Gemini API
scenes.say: Gemini 1.0 was announced in December 2023. Gemini 3 Pro arrived as a preview in November 2025, the Antigravity agent came to the Gemini API in May 2026, and Gemini 3.8 Flash became generally available on September 2.
